notes: Draft from `compare-snapshots.ts suggest` on Digdir v1.23.0 and Udir 2026-10-22, limited to cases supported by code or certain from the names. To be confirmed with the designer.

Not included yet: `.Scalable checkmark` (maybe Digdir's `.Scalable checkmark/medium`), `.input radio` (variant names differ), `_tab elements base` (case of state values), Dropdown, SkipLink/neutral and `.BaseTekst og understrek` (fixed to neutral in Figma, but not restricted to neutral in code), and the components using slots besides Card.

IconButton.reason: Button with an icon; same restriction as Button

Breadcrumbs.reason: Breadcrumbs.tsx omits data-color; `.ds-breadcrumbs` is reset to neutral in postprocess-css-colors.ts

Link.reason: Link.tsx omits data-color; `.ds-link` is reset to neutral in postprocess-css-colors.ts

Pagination.reason: Pagination.tsx omits data-color; `.ds-pagination` is reset to neutral in postprocess-css-colors.ts

ToggleGroup.reason: ToggleGroup.tsx omits data-color; `.ds-togglegroup` is reset to neutral in postprocess-css-colors.ts

IconToggleGroup.reason: ToggleGroup with icons; same restriction as ToggleGroup

.input checkbox.reason: Checkbox.tsx omits data-color; `.ds-input` is reset to neutral in postprocess-css-colors.ts. Danger for the error state, as in Digdir

.input radio.reason: Radio renders `.ds-input`, which is reset to neutral in postprocess-css-colors.ts. Danger for the error state, as in Digdir

Switch.reason: Switch.tsx omits data-color; Digdir's Switch renders `.ds-field` and `.ds-input`, which are reset to neutral in postprocess-css-colors.ts

.Item in suggestion.reason: Part of Suggestion; `.ds-suggestion` is reset to neutral in postprocess-css-colors.ts

.Item in multiselect.reason: Part of Suggestion (multiple); `.ds-suggestion` is reset to neutral in postprocess-css-colors.ts

.Clearable.reason: Clear button in Suggestion and Search, which render `.ds-input` and `.ds-suggestion`, reset to neutral in postprocess-css-colors.ts

restructured.Card: Rebuilt with Figma slots (Container slot 1, Container slot 2, Image slot); Digdir's library doesn't use slots
